method: CodeCarbon offline, assumed CPU TDP and constant RAM power
scope: Six quantile fits: exact training repeat and lockdown-excluded sensitivity, plus validation prediction/checks; excludes original historical training, data preparation, final test, development and AI assistance.
limitations: An estimate, not a wall-meter measurement. Uses bundled country-average electricity intensity, not historical household emissions or a current NSW marginal factor. Other machine activity and embodied emissions are not attributed.
cpu_method_note: CodeCarbon 3.0.7 constant mode uses 50% of the supplied CPU TDP; effective CPU watts are recorded in cpu_power.
